race.description: Ocean Air Custom Airconditioning Solutions Mdn
race.comment: MAKE IT SNOW (10) was solid on debut before just missing at Bunbury last start over 1400m, beaten a nose. He was in the market on both occasions and while he has drawn wide, he's shown versatility early in his career. Azzopardi reunites with him and a forward showing is on the cards. PERFECT SCORE (9) is the main danger after flying home over 1100m at this track last time out as an odds-on pop. The form out of that has worked out well and now out to this trip for the first time looks a big tick. Looks set to raise the bar. IL BELLO BEALS (1) is a long-time maiden but continues to run well. Drawn nicely and has placed on numerous occasions at this track and trip. THE NUTTY NURSE (11) is improving with racing, missing by 1.5L here last time out at big odds. Include. AUBURN (4) next best.
